text: My stepson is 9 and has a temperature of 38.7. He won't put his chin down to his chest, he says it hurts too much so he keeps his head dead straight and can't look down at his belly. I asked him three times. His colour looks normal, lips are pink, and he hasn't had any fits or shaking or anything like that. I'm really frightened, his dad's working nights and I don't know whether to wait or go now
